game.name: Namco Museum : Virtual Arcade (Europe)
game.desc: Namco Museum: Virtual Arcade on Xbox 360 features over 30 retro arcade games including: Ms. Pac-Man, Galaga, Dig Dug, Pac-Man Championship Edition, Mr. Driller Online and Galaga Legions. High scores are posted online. New versions of these classic games are also included.
